description: every gate is shifted 24 to one side of the centreline
find:
a: { x: p.x + nx * gateHalf, y: p.y + ny * gateHalf },
      b: { x: p.x - nx * gateHalf, y: p.y - ny * gateHalf },
replace:
a: { x: p.x + nx * (gateHalf + 24), y: p.y + ny * (gateHalf + 24) },
      b: { x: p.x - nx * (gateHalf - 24), y: p.y - ny * (gateHalf - 24) },
